messages:
maya_sales: FYI — AcmePay RFP just came in. They attached a 40‑page security questionnaire and want a POC that shows card-data redaction + private deployment within 3 weeks. Main asks: on‑prem HSM/KMS, FedRAMP equivalency, regional data residency, and SLA. They also call out sustained throughput of ~300 reqs/s for peak. Sharing attachments here; need feasibility check. @arjun_se can you confirm Dedicated vs Private viability?

arjun_se: Ack. I'll scope infra. Quick clarifying Q: do they require full on‑prem air‑gapped, or is VPC-private control plane acceptable? The questionnaire references 'customer managed network' and also lists an 'on-site appliance' option.

maya_sales: The doc (section 2.1) says 'private deployment (VPC or on‑prem) — preference: VPC peering first, on‑prem if required.' So recommend we default to VPC peering approach for speed.

priya_security: Tagging security — flagged items: HSM-backed key management, FedRAMP equivalency evidence, audit log retention (7 years), segmentation/tenant isolation controls. Need to confirm whether AcmePay will accept KMS with envelope encryption or mandates HSM for tokenization keys.

arjun_se: From product: Private supports customer KMS integrations (via KMS proxy) and optional HSM for on‑prem installations. POC options I propose: (A) VPC peering + customer KMS (no HSM) — fastest to spin up; (B) On‑prem package with HSM integration — higher confidence but longer lead. I'll draft two runbooks plus a capacity plan for 300 rps.

liam_ae: Pricing heads-up: Dedicated reserved capacity can be offered with a 6‑month commit (we can do ~15% discount). On‑prem is enterprise licensing + deployment + support fees. Need to decide whether to treat the POC as a billable short-term demo (we usually credit against commit) and also confirm egress fee handling for the pilot.

sara_legal: I'm on NDA & SLA. If they request 99.95% SLA for private with premium support, legal will need ~4 weeks for redlines. Send me the specific SLA asks. Also, please attach any compliance artifacts (SOC2, ISO27001) — I can drop them into the response pack.

maya_sales: Action list: 1) Arjun — capacity + two POC runbooks + time estimate (can you do an initial draft by EOD?) 2) Priya — list required evidence docs & gaps 3) Sara — redline timeline + fallback SLA language 4) Liam — preliminary pricing slides for both POC options. Target POC kickoff: 2/09.

arjun_se: Yes — I'll post a POC runbook by EOD. Plan: start with staging-private (VPC peering) benchmark: 8x A100 mixed nodes, autoscale to 12 for peaks. Will run load-test harness (wrk-like) with 300 rps sustained for 10m intervals and a token distribution resembling production (average 750 tokens). I'll include a short script and expected perf charts.

deploy-bot: demo-deploy-123 initiated by arjun_se — private-demo (env: staging-private) — logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/7890

priya_security: Uploaded: /attachments/acmepay-security-gaplist.pdf. Tomorrow 10:30am quick call to walk gating items? Recommend invite: Maya, Arjun, Liam, Sara + customer security lead.

maya_sales: 10:30 works. I'll invite the AcmePay SRE & security lead and set a 30‑minute agenda: goals, POC options (A/B), timeline, data handling & controls.

liam_ae: SalesOps note: customer asked for a binding cap on egress for the pilot. Recommend offering a fixed egress credit for the POC (e.g., $2k) and then standard tiered egress charges in production. Thoughts?

maya_sales: Good call — include that as an explicit POC term. I'll draft a one‑page RFI summary and attach both POC options + pricing. Thanks team :thumbsup:
